xc_files.name: code.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
var $hudtoggle = 0
function@transhud()
	var $speed = input_number("speed", 2)
	$speed = $speed*3.6
	var $alt = input_number("alt", 1)
	var $fuel = input_number("volume", 0)

	var $hud = screen("hud_transparent", 0)
	$hud.blank(0)
	if input_number("mainboard", 28) == 1
		$hudtoggle++
		if $hudtoggle == 1
			$hudtoggle = $hudtoggle
		else
			$hudtoggle = 0
			
	if $hudtoggle == 1

		$hud.text_align(top)
		$hud.text_size(2)
		$hud.write(0,8,white,text("{0} KPH", $speed))
		$hud.text_align(bottom)
		$hud.write(0,-15,white,text("{0} M", $alt))
		
		$hud.draw_rect(10, 125-100*$fuel, 45, 125, 0, green)
		$hud.draw_rect(10, 25, 45, 125, white)
	
		
tick
	@transhud()

xc_files.name: main.xc
xc_files.plain_code:
var $p = panel(top,500,500)
var $blue2 = color(153, 219, 233)
var $blue3 = color(59, 102, 111)
var $blue4 = color(5, 56, 172)
var $purple2 = color(79, 5, 197)
var $orange2 = color(255, 153, 0)
var $transgray1 = color(50, 50, 50, 100)
var $transgray2 = color(50, 50, 50, 100)
var $transgray3 = color(50, 50, 50, 100)
var $transblack = color(20, 20, 20, 120)
var $toggle = 0
var $toggle2 = 0
var $toggle3 = 0
var $numcolour = 0

tick
	$p.blank()
	$p.text_align(top)
	$p.text_size(2)
	$p.write(2,12,$blue3,text("Speed: {0} km/h", get("avatar_sensor_speed")*3.6))
	$p.write(0,12,$blue2,text("Speed: {0} km/h", get("avatar_sensor_speed")*3.6))
	$p.text_size(1)
	$p.write(2,35,$blue3,text("Alt: {0.0} m", get("avatar_sensor_altitude")))
	$p.write(0,35,$blue2,text("Alt: {0.0} m", get("avatar_sensor_altitude")))
	
	
	if $p.button_rect(10,40,95,60,$blue2,$transgray1)
		$toggle!!
	$p.text_size(1)
	$p.write(-197,45,$blue2,"Aim Distance")
	
	if $toggle == 1
		$transgray1 = color(150, 150, 150, 180)
		$p.text_align(center)
		$p.text_size(1)
		$p.write(1,35,$blue3, text("{0.00}km", aim_distance/1000))
		$p.write(0,35,$blue2, text("{0.00}km", aim_distance/1000))
	else
		$transgray1 = color(50, 50, 50, 100)
	
	if $p.button_rect(-6+400,40,100+400,60,$blue2,$transgray2)
		$toggle2!!
		
	$p.text_align(top)
	$p.write(198,45,$blue2,"Enviroment Stats")
	if $toggle2 == 1
		$transgray2 = color(150, 150, 150, 180)
		var $comp = get("avatar_sensor_environment_composition")
		$p.text_align(right)
		$p.write(0,-170,$blue2,text("Density: {0.00} kg/m3", get("avatar_sensor_density")))
		$p.write(0,-160,$blue2,"Composition")
		$p.write(0,-150,$blue2,text("N2: {}%", $comp.N2*100))
		$p.write(0,-140,$blue2,text("O2: {}%", $comp.O2*100))
		$p.write(0,-130,$blue2,text("H20: {}%", $comp.H2O*100))
		$p.write(0,-120,$blue2,text("C02: {}%", $comp.CO2*100))
		$p.write(0,-110,$blue2,text("CH4: {}%", $comp.CH4*100))
	else
		$transgray2 = color(50, 50, 50, 100)
	
	if $p.button_rect(4+105,40,86+105,60,$blue2,$transgray3)
		$toggle3!!
	$p.text_size(1)
	$p.text_align(top)
	$p.write(-100,45,$blue2,"Instructions")
	
	if $toggle3 == 1
		$transgray3 = color(150, 150, 150, 180)
		$p.text_align(center)
		$p.text_size(1)
		$p.draw_rect(100,90,400,275,$blue2,$transblack)
		;instructions
		
		$p.write(-120,-140, white, "Step 1")
		
		$p.write(-25,-125, white, "Flip the 'hover' switch and use the")
		$p.write(-28,-115, white, "up/down arrows to set a hover alt.")
		
		$p.write(-120,-100, white, "Step 2")
		
		$p.write(-16,-85, white, "Press the 'engines' & 'pump' switches.")
		
		$p.write(-120,-70, white, "Step 3")
		
		$p.write(-38,-55, white, "Congrats, you are now airborne.")
		$p.write(-3,-45, white, "You can turn on the hud to see flight info.")
		
		$p.write(-120,-30, white, "Step 4")
		
		$p.write(7,-15, white, "W/S will pivot the engines, <-/-> is your yaw.")
		
		
		
		
		
		$p.write(1,36, $blue3, "Thanks for downloading my build!")
		$p.write(0,36, $blue2, "Thanks for downloading my build!")
		
		
		
	else
		$transgray3 = color(50, 50, 50, 100)
		
	;smile
	var $varcolour = yellow
	if $numcolour > 5
		$numcolour = 0
		
	if $numcolour == 1
		$varcolour = $orange2
	if $numcolour == 2
		$varcolour = red
	if $numcolour == 3
		$varcolour = $purple2
	if $numcolour == 4
		$varcolour = $blue4
	if $numcolour == 5
		$varcolour = green
	if $p.button_circle(360,50,12,$blue2,$varcolour)
		$numcolour++
	
	$p.draw_circle(360,50,8,black)
	$p.draw_circle(360,48,8,$varcolour,$varcolour)
	
	$p.draw_point(356,47,black)
	$p.draw_point(357,47,black)
	$p.draw_point(356,48,black)
	$p.draw_point(357,48,black)
	
	$p.draw_point(364,47,black)
	$p.draw_point(365,47,black)
	$p.draw_point(365,48,black)
	$p.draw_point(364,48,black)
